domain.criticalJustificationForAdjacentRootEdit: The project already placed the culling scheduler, AUP cache refresh, and deferred Rigidbody Sleep/Wake sync in the root GlobalPhysicsStateManager partial. Hardening those methods is required to fix physics culling without duplicating authority.
domain.criticalJustificationForCoreSignalContra: WakeRequestSignal and PhysicsImpactSignal are direct cross-domain DTOs consumed by Physics culling wake routing. Padding-only contract edits keep ABI sizes/semantic offsets stable while satisfying byte-padding ARM64 proof.
domain.criticalJustificationForPhysicsApplyEdit: PhysicsApplySystem.cs is explicitly named in the 1337 prompt and owns deferred Rigidbody force/event payloads plus kinematic weld snap routing. DTO layout and direct force cleanup are inside the culling/sleep coordination surface.
domain.criticalJustificationForGlobalPhysicsScr: GlobalPhysicsStateManager owns physics culling collider/sleep registration caches. Raising cold scratch capacity prevents List<T> growth during culling registration without changing semantic cached collider limits.

defectsFound.fact: TryUpdateTrackedBodyAupCache returns LastValidAup before sampling the current Rigidbody position, so moving bodies can be culled from stale coordinates.
ResolvePhysicsCullingHardwareRadiusSqScale returns a fixed 2.25 instead of consuming continuous HomeostasisBrain.GlobalQualityWeight.
Frame telemetry is explicit but only 32 bytes and lacks job/sync microsecond and quality proof fields.
DumpPhysicsCullingBlackBox only pushes GlobalTelemetryBus event; it does not dump the 300-frame native ring to Docs/AgentLogs.
WakeCulledBodiesNear fell back to forced job completion and an O(N) tracked-body scan when deferred wake-region enqueue failed.
FrozenVelocityDTO and PhysicsCullingDebugBody placed semantic byte flags after byte-padding holes instead of at the start of the 1-byte section.
Targeted wake flush mutated multiple Vault lanes through per-indexer fallback locks instead of one scoped compaction-aware write-lock phase.
WakeCulledBodiesNear incremented contention for every false enqueue return, double-counting real failures and misclassifying invalid input or floating-origin shift.

ProcessTargetedPhysicsWakeRequest called RemoveTrackedBodyAt for stale/null Rigidbody while targeted wake flush locks were held; RemoveTrackedBodyAt begins with CompletePhysicsCullingJobForStateMutationBarrier(discardResults: true).
RunPhysicsCullingSlowTick and DispatchPhysicsCullingResults could call RemoveTrackedBodyAt for null Rigidbody while scoped scheduling/dispatch Vault write locks were held.
When removedBody was null, RemoveTrackedBodyAt could not remove the old _trackedBodyIndexByInstanceId key, allowing targeted wake lookup to hit the body swapped into that lane.
FixedTick ran ApplyColliderLodHysteresisInternal every physics step, scanning all tracked bodies despite a 5-second simplification hysteresis.
FixedTick ran ApplyAddedMassTensorState over all tracked bodies every physics step even though tensor changes only depend on rare hydrodynamic submersion updates.
EvaluateConnections cleared compensation/culling ref counts by scanning every tracked body each FixedTick, even when connection ownership is bounded by MaxTrackedConnections.
PhysicsCullingTelemetryEntry placed 4-byte fields after ushort/byte fields; the 64B size was correct but the pointer-first/field-width ordering proof was not.
Null tracked-body cleanup could still route through RemoveTrackedBodyAt while a culling job was active; that method force-completes/discards active culling work as a structural mutation barrier.
BufferID.RigidbodyAUPs is consumed by rollback/hash reports as AupExactDouble3, but the physics owner published camera-relative delta values during culling refresh.
PhysicsImpactSignal used uint/ulong tail padding after byte fields even though GlobalPhysicsStateManager emits and consumes this payload for impact wake routing.
ClearShinobu37PhysicsCullingState cleared multiple Vault-backed culling lanes through repeated indexer-level write locks instead of a scoped reset transaction.

ClearRuntimeState cleared root impact, last-position, AUP, result, distance, awake, command, and body telemetry lanes through repeated indexer-level Vault write locks instead of a scoped reset transaction.
RefreshTrackedBodies wrote _lastValidPositions through VaultBufferBinding indexer for every finite tracked body every FixedTick, causing per-body write-lock churn in the owner-thread physics path.
Force/acoustic/event DTOs used ushort/uint/ulong tail padding after semantic byte fields, violating the byte-padding ARM64 proof even though sizes and semantic offsets were stable.
PhysicsCullingLayout1337 did not validate ForcePacket, acoustic event DTOs, or RemovedPhysicsEventPayload, leaving PhysicsApplySystem payload layout proof as a manual report only.
ApplyKinematicWeldSnap applied a VelocityChange impulse and then immediately made the body kinematic, zeroed velocities, snapped pose, and slept it, wasting a direct PhysX force call.
PostFixedTick could call EnsureForcePacketBuffers/EnsureValidationBuffers through the swap/validation path, allowing IDataVault.EnsureGenerationHandle from a hot fixed-step swap path.
Force packet enqueue, validation-copy, flush clear, and clear-queued paths wrote Vault-owned NativeArray views without TryAcquireWriteLock/ReleaseWriteLock proof.
Collider discovery used small List<T> scratch capacities, so normal compound bodies or submarine hulls could grow managed lists during registration or first hull arm.
ValidateForcePacketsJob was scheduled against Vault-backed validation packet/mask views without registering the active JobHandle through H8Memory.

phase0Decision: Patch existing owner path. Do not add parallel culling authority.

codeChanges: Fixed body AUP refresh so current rigidbody position is sampled each culling slow tick, with last-valid AUP only as invalid-position fallback.
Replaced constant culling radius hardware scale with continuous HomeostasisBrain.GlobalQualityWeight smoothstep mapping.
Widened frame and body telemetry rings to 64-byte explicit layouts with job/sync microseconds, quality, radius scale, lock contentions, and hashes.
Added raw black-box dump to Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_1337_PhysicsCulling.bin.
Added cold ARM64 layout validator and editor mock-spam fuzzer menu.
Added scoped GlobalDataVault write-lock acquisition/release wrappers for Physics culling scheduling and result dispatch phases.
Moved invalid-input black-box dumping out of the dispatch write-lock phase by recording scalar dump intent and emitting after finally-release.
Removed unused legacy PhysicsDistanceCullingJob from GlobalPhysicsStateManager.cs.
Rewrote active Shinobu37 solver decisions to mask/math.select style; remaining job Execute if-statements are fail-closed bounds guards only.
Removed remaining short-circuit boolean OR from the scheduled solver body by converting sleepActive and IsOutsideFrustum OR reductions to non-short-circuit boolean OR.
Moved normal acoustic/impact/WakeRequest wake pulses into the Burst wake lane with value-copied AUP wake-region payloads and kept the O(N) immediate wake scan only as fallback.
Added wake-job schedule timestamp and H8Memory active-job registration so wake batches use the same accounting route as distance culling jobs.
Moved targeted wake requests out of pre-schedule job-result scratch lanes and into direct owner-phase restore; removed the dead manual changed-index helper.
Removed hot-path EnsureNativeState calls from targeted and region wake enqueue routes; wake lanes now fail closed and publish through scoped method-local Vault write locks.
Replaced WakeRequestSignal tail padding ulong fields with explicit private byte padding and added WakeRequestSignal size/offset checks to PhysicsCullingLayout1337.

Removed immediate WakeCulledBodiesNear fallback on deferred wake-region enqueue failure; overflow now fails closed through contention telemetry instead of force-completing jobs and scanning all tracked bodies.
Moved FrozenVelocityDTO and PhysicsCullingDebugBody byte flags to the start of their 1-byte sections and expanded PhysicsCullingLayout1337 offset validation.
Wrapped targeted wake flush in scoped Vault write locks for wake mirror, wake count, frozen velocity, state age, and DTO lanes.
Removed caller-side contention increment from WakeCulledBodiesNear so invalid/shift false returns do not pollute lock telemetry and real failures are counted once by TryQueuePhysicsCullingWakeRegion.
Changed null-body targeted wake handling to fail closed with return; stale body cleanup remains owned by normal structural unregister/removal paths outside the targeted wake flush lock phase.
Added RemoveNullTrackedBodiesOutsidePhysicsCullingLocks and moved null tracked-body structural cleanup outside scheduling and dispatch Vault write-lock phases.
Cached RigidbodyState.EntityInstanceHash and remove cached entity/instance dictionary keys before lane swap, even for destroyed/null Unity objects.
Moved collider LOD hysteresis from fixed-step cadence to the slow-cadence physics culling budget while preserving elapsed-time hysteresis accounting.
Replaced per-FixedTick added-mass O(N) scanning with a bounded preallocated dirty-index queue marked by SetHydrodynamicSubmersionInternal and drained once per owner FixedTick.
Requeued moved dirty added-mass state during tracked-body lane swaps and cleared the dirty queue during ClearRuntimeState.
Replaced EvaluateConnections all-body ref clearing with a bounded previous-touched connection body index list and one-shot full-clear fallback after structural body removal.
Reordered private PhysicsCullingTelemetryEntry fields and validator offsets so 4-byte fields precede 2-byte and 1-byte fields with explicit tail byte padding.
Added TryRemoveNullTrackedBodyAt and _deferredNullTrackedBodyCleanup so null-body cleanup cannot force-complete active culling jobs or run structural lane mutation inside Vault lock phases.
Changed BufferID.RigidbodyAUPs publication to AbsoluteUniversePosition.ToAbsoluteDouble3() so rollback/hash consumers receive authoritative exact AUP double3 values.

Replaced PhysicsImpactSignal tail uint/ulong padding with explicit byte padding at offsets 104..127 and added PhysicsImpactSignal plus PhysicsImpactEventData layout checks to PhysicsCullingLayout1337.

Added scoped Shinobu37 reset clear write-lock acquisition/release for created DTO, spatial hash, wake mirror/count, changed-count, frame telemetry, and mock wake lanes; reset releases in finally and retains guarded fallback if a scoped lock is unavailable.

Added scoped root runtime clear write-lock acquisition/release for impact, last-position, AUP, culling result, distance, awake, command, and body telemetry lanes; root reset releases in finally and keeps guarded fallback semantics.

Changed RefreshTrackedBodies to acquire the last-valid-position Vault lane once per FixedTick, write through the resolved NativeArray<float3>, release in finally, and defer null-body structural cleanup outside that lock window.

Replaced PhysicsApplySystem ForcePacket, AcousticPingEvent, AcousticImpulseEvent, LargeAcousticImpulseEvent, and RemovedPhysicsEventPayload wide tail padding with explicit private byte padding while preserving sizes and semantic offsets.
Expanded PhysicsCullingLayout1337 to validate PhysicsApplySystem force/acoustic/event DTO sizes and key offsets, including first and last byte-padding offsets.
Removed the discarded ApplyKinematicWeldSnap correction AddForce because the same method immediately sets kinematic state, zeroes velocities, snaps pose, and sleeps the body.
Removed hot EnsureGenerationHandle route from PhysicsApplySystem PostFixedTick: force packet buffer swap now fails closed when existing Vault handles are missing.
Wrapped PhysicsApplySystem force-packet back/front/validation/mask writes in IDataVault.TryAcquireWriteLock helpers with finally ReleaseWriteLock.
Raised GlobalPhysicsStateManager mesh/sleep collider and PhysicsApplySystem submarine collider scratch List capacities to 64 cold slots to avoid normal compound-body discovery growth.
Registered ValidateForcePacketsJob with H8Memory immediately after Schedule and cleared the active job on normal/forced completion.
